verse_extra: the shared stage: summon a card and both people see it
first_page: Chat page /chat/ for two or a few people who want to talk without phone numbers. First: open a room, share its link, send end-to-end encrypted text (key in the link fragment, WebCrypto) relayed through the existing share room, with reactions, replies, read marks and history kept only on each device; any card summoned in the room shows for everyone. Will not build: phone-number accounts, calls, status, channels or file uploads past a small limit.
